title: 第一卷第5章 世态炎凉第一卷第6章 我脾气有点爆

萧家破败小院。
君无邪回来时，小月瑶依然在熟睡。
他坐在床前，用手指挖出些润肤生肌膏，轻轻抹在她的冻疮上。
“无邪哥哥。”
月瑶睫毛颤动，睁开眼睛，扑闪扑闪地看着他，偷偷地笑了。
现在这样真好，无邪哥哥终于好啦，她再也不用担惊受怕啦。
君无邪刮了刮她的小鼻子，柔声说道：“哥哥是不是吵醒你了？”
“不是的，月瑶睡醒啦。”小月瑶抱着君无邪的手臂，使劲将脑袋往他的怀里拱，道：“以前哥哥生病的时候，月瑶好害怕的，萧奇他们总是欺负我们。月瑶没用，保护不了哥哥……”
“傻瓜，只有哥哥保护妹妹的，哪有让妹妹保护哥哥的？”
“不嘛，月瑶就是想保护哥哥，月瑶好想快点长大呀，长大了就可以修炼啦。”她说到这里气哼哼地挥着小拳头：“到时候谁敢欺负哥哥，月瑶就揍哭他！”
“月瑶。”君无邪把她紧紧抱在怀里，道：“从今往后，谁也不能再欺负你，谁敢欺负你，我必杀他！”
“无邪哥哥，你将来会离开月瑶么？”
“不会的。”
“那月瑶要一辈子跟哥哥在一起，好不好？”
“一辈子怎么够，哥哥要陪着瑶儿这辈子，下辈子，下下辈子，永远永远……”
“嘻嘻，无邪哥哥说话算话哦，不许骗月瑶哦～我们拉钩钩～”
……
君无邪背着月瑶的小药篓，抱着她离开了萧家。
他要去做悬赏任务，不放心将她留在这里。

不知何时，萧旭引发的异象已散去，天也恢复了白昼。
萧家热闹无比。
一路上，萧家众人看到君无邪，都露出难以置信的表情，但很快又面露不屑，议论纷纷。
“没想到，他还能恢复过来。只可惜啊，曾经的天才，那时多么的耀眼啊，可如今即便是恢复了，在萧旭的璀璨光辉下，也是黯淡无光。”
“唔，说的是，他就算恢复了以前的天赋，也已跌落了神坛，唯有萧旭才是我们青阳城最璀璨耀眼的天才！”
“呵呵，一枚家族弃子罢了，亏得我们曾经还把他捧得那么高……”
……
各种嘲讽不断。
对于萧家上下来说，萧旭成为天命使者，引来惊人的星空异象，那是绝对的天纵奇才，君无邪就算恢复了，比起萧旭来也是差远了。
君无邪没有理会，这些人曾经在他耀眼时趋之若鹜，而今却冷嘲热讽，人性凉薄，莫过于此。
现在若是去回应他们，没有任何意义，只有在众目睽睽下，强势击败他们所谓的奇才，才是最好的回应方式。
他到了萧家大门口时，看到了人山人海的景象。
城中各大小势力的掌权者携重礼，排队上门道贺。
那些人看到他时不免感到震惊，但随即又摇了摇头，没有任何人跟他打招呼。
君无邪也不在意这些，如今是萧旭得势，所有人的眼里自然只有那个天命使者了。
“毕家家主毕凤林及众长老携礼来贺！”
“吉家家主吉翔及众长老携礼来贺！”
“江家家主江辰及众长老携礼来贺！”
“青阳城主汪诚携礼来贺！”
……

萧家一时春风得意，便是门口的守卫都高昂着头颅，看各势力高层的眼神已然没有了以往的敬畏。
“挤什么挤，后面排队去！”
萧奇也在门口，只是没有看到从府中出来的君无邪，心思都在这些前来道贺的人身上。

The Xiao family's dilapidated courtyard.
When Jun Wuxie came back, Xiao Yueyao was still sleeping soundly.
He sat in front of the bed, dug out some moisturizing cream with his fingers, and gently applied it on her chilblains.
"Brother Wuxie."
Yueyao's eyelashes trembled, she opened her eyes, looked at him with fluttering eyes, and smiled secretly.
It's great to be like this now. Brother Wuxie is finally well, and she doesn't have to worry anymore.
Jun Wuxie scratched her little nose and said softly, "Did brother wake you up?"
"No, Yueyao woke up." Xiao Yueyao held Jun Wuxie's arm and pushed her head into his arms, saying: "When my brother was sick in the past, Yueyao was so scared. Xiao Qi and the others always bullied us. Yueyao is useless and can't protect my brother..."
"Fool, only the elder brother protects the younger sister. How can a younger sister protect her older brother?"
"No, Yue Yao just wants to protect her brother. Yue Yao really wants to grow up quickly. When she grows up, she can practice." She said angrily and waved her fists: "Whoever dares to bully my brother will be beaten to tears by Yue Yao!"
"Yue Yao." Jun Wuxie held her tightly in his arms and said, "From now on, no one can bully you anymore. Whoever dares to bully you, I will kill him!"
"Brother Wuxie, will you leave Yueyao in the future?"
"No."
"Then Yueyao will stay with her brother for the rest of her life, okay?"
"How can one life be enough? My brother will accompany Yaoer in this life, the next life, the next life, forever and ever..."
"Hee hee, brother Wuxie keeps his word, don't lie to Yueyao~ Let's hook up~"
…
Jun Wuxie carried Yueyao's small medicine basket on her back and left the Xiao family with her in her arms.
He was going to do a bounty mission and was worried about leaving her here.
At some point, the vision caused by Xiao Xu dissipated, and daylight returned to the sky.
The Xiao family was extremely lively.
Along the way, everyone in the Xiao family showed disbelief when they saw Jun Wuxie, but soon they showed disdain and started talking.
"I didn't expect that he could recover. It's a pity that the genius once was so dazzling at that time, but now even if he recovers, he is dimmed under Xiao Xu's dazzling light."
"Well, what I'm saying is that even if he recovers his previous talent, he has fallen off the altar. Only Xiao Xu is the most dazzling genius in our Qingyang City!"
"Haha, he is just an abandoned son of the family. Fortunately, we once held him up so high..."
…
All kinds of ridicule continued.
For everyone in the Xiao family, Xiao Xu became the messenger of destiny and caused astonishing starry sky visions. He was an absolute genius. Even if Jun Wuxie recovered, he was still far behind Xiao Xu.
Jun Wuxie ignored him. These people used to flock to him when he was dazzling, but now they were sarcastic and sarcastic. There was nothing more humane than this.
There is no point in responding to them now. The best way to respond is to forcefully defeat their so-called wizards in front of everyone.
When he arrived at the gate of Xiao's house, he saw a huge crowd of people.
The powerful people from all the big and small forces in the city lined up with heavy gifts to express their congratulations.
Those people were shocked when they saw him, but then they shook their heads, and no one said hello to him.
Jun Wuxie didn't care about this. Now that Xiao Xu was in power, everyone only had eyes for the messenger of destiny.
"The head of the Bi family, Bi Fenglin, and all the elders came to congratulate us with gifts!"
"The head of the Ji family, Ji Xiang, and all the elders are here to congratulate us with gifts!"
"The head of the Jiang family, Jiang Chen, and all the elders are here to congratulate us with gifts!"
"Qingyang City Lord Wang Cheng comes to congratulate you with gifts!"
…
The Xiao family was so proud that even the guards at the door held their heads high and looked at the top leaders of various forces without the awe they had in the past.
"Why are you so crowded? Go in line at the back!"
Xiao Qi was also at the door, but he didn't see Jun Wuxie coming out of the mansion. His thoughts were on these people who came to congratulate him.
